Messages.Author: KingJohann
Messages.Body:
If I am playing a Ravnos deck with a mass reality out, and pull out a zip gun
during combat, is the damage dealt by zip gun to my minion increased as well?

Thanks

DF

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <20010201180155...@ng-bd1.aol.com>,
KingJohann <kingj...@aol.com> wrote:

>If I am playing a Ravnos deck with a mass reality out, and pull out a zip gun
>during combat, is the damage dealt by zip gun to my minion increased as well?

No. As I recall, Mass Reality increases damage a weapon 'inflicts.' This is
taken to be damage done to the opposing target by striking with the weapon.

Anything else the equipment does is a side-effect and unaffected by Mass
Reality. It just happens that ZipGun has a side-effect resulting in
dealing damage, like the .44 magnum has a side effect resulting in an
optional maneuver, but side-effects are outside of Mass Reality's purview.

In the same way, Talbot's Chainsaw would inflict +1/+2 damage with a
Mass Reality in play, but you would still only have to inflict 3 damage
to minion you control during untap, not 4 or 5.

gomi

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3a7cdf6d$0$70805$1dc6...@news.corecomm.net>,

Tim Olivas <tol...@megsinet.net> wrote:
>The Superior Spying Mission effect says it is used "if a bleed is
>sucessful". Does a Methuselah using superior Spying Mission still get
>the Edge, even though no pool is lost?

Short answer: No.

Long answer: Superior SM is played when a bleed would have been successful.
Playing SM makes it an unsuccessful bleed (bleeds for 0 or less are
not considered successful, and do not therefore garner the Edge). Note that
the action itself is successful, for cards that care about such things
(inferior Freak Drive, Blood of the Sabbat, et alia).

> Is this true of all weapons that do environmental damage to the

they do to the opposing minion. The damage done to the wielder
will not be affected in any way by Mass Reality.
